episode_title: Friday watchlist: Canva AI 2.0 is the workflow test worth trying first
selected_story_title: Canva AI 2.0 is in research preview
selection_reason: This is the most immediately useful release for creators and small businesses because it is aimed at getting from idea to editable asset inside a real workflow. Unlike a broad model upgrade, it targets everyday production tasks and is available now as a preview for people who can test it on real work.
first_spoken_line: Today’s biggest story is not a bigger model headline. It is a workflow story.
final_spoken_line: If it did, keep going. If it did not, wait. But this is the kind of release worth putting in front of a real workflow, not just a demo.
